question: Will Peggy Flanagan be the Democratic nominee for Senate in Minnesota?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Democratic Primary for United States Senator from Minnesota.

If no 2026 Minnesota Democratic Senate Primary takes place, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the Minnesota Democratic party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

evidence.publisher: Democratic Lieutenant Governors Association (poll sponsor supporting Flanagan; poll conducted by Public Policy Polling)
evidence.excerpt: A Public Policy Polling survey conducted July 23–24, 2026 among 672 likely Minnesota Democratic primary voters found Peggy Flanagan leading Angie Craig 46% to 32%. The Democratic Lieutenant Governors Association's July 28 release reported that Flanagan's lead had increased from seven points in its previous month's survey.

SurveyUSA's July 15–20 survey of 513 likely Minnesota Democratic primary voters found Craig and Flanagan tied at 40% each. Comparing its June and July surveys showed a net gain of five percentage points for Flanagan. Craig held a fundraising advantage and approximately $5 million in cash on hand, compared with $1.5 million for Flanagan.

Delegates to the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party convention endorsed Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan for United States Senate on May 30, 2026. The party announcement listed support from Senator Tina Smith, Attorney General Keith Ellison, State Auditor Julie Blaha, a majority of DFL legislators and several labor unions.
